## Spare Part

`partNumber`, `name`, `description`, `compatibleCategories[]`, `compatibleAssets[]`, `preferredVendor` (Vendor), `stock` (**Inventory Stock**, optional; else the local `quantityOnHand`), `reorderPoint`, `reorderQuantity`, `unitCost`. Computed `onHand`, `belowReorderPoint`, `stockState` (ok | low | out).

**Complete Work Order** decrements stock for `fromStock` Part Usage lines; **Reorder Spare Parts** (v1.1) raises a Purchase Requisition per vendor for parts below their reorder point.
